extraction_notes: P-channel datasheet values are stored as positive magnitudes; signed datasheet conditions are retained.
No transfer-characteristics, output-characteristics, or capacitance-versus-VDS figures are present in the supplied four-page datasheet, so no curve points were digitized or interpolated.
The datasheet also lists IDSS max 1 uA magnitude at VDS = -20 V and VGS = 0 V, and IGSS max 100 nA magnitude at VDS = 0 V and VGS = +/-8 V; these have no dedicated fields in the supplied schema.

The datasheet lists typical switching values at VGS = -4.5 V, VDD = -4.0 V, ID = -1.0 A, and RG = 6.2 ohm: td(on) = 6.2 ns, tr = 15 ns, td(off) = 26 ns, and tf = 18 ns; these have no dedicated fields in the supplied schema.

Absolute maximum ratings include VDS = -20 V, VGS = +/-8 V, continuous ID = -1.4 A, pulsed IDM = -3.0 A, PD = 0.29 W, RthetaJA = 431 degC/W, TJ = 150 degC, and storage temperature = -50 to +150 degC; these have no dedicated fields in the supplied schema.
The supplied datasheet does not state a revision.
The tabulated capacitance values are used as terminal capacitances only; no capacitance-versus-VDS curve is available for extracting a nonlinear gate-drain capacitance family.
